description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing the watch notification inbox in an Apple Watch app. It includes handling of notification messages, persisting state, and interacting with the user interface and notifications.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: An observable, main-actor class responsible for managing the state of the watch notification inbox, including receiving messages, persisting state, and posting local notifications.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, updates the inbox state, and triggers a local notification.

methods.name: restorePersistedState
methods.description: Restores the inbox state from user defaults upon initialization.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Saves the current inbox state to user defaults.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a message based on its ID or content.

methods.name: ensureNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and requests notification authorization from the user.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps message risk levels to corresponding haptic feedback types.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a draft reply based on the current prompt and action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Updates state to indicate a reply is being sent.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates the reply UI based on the result of sending a reply.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Posts a local notification to the user based on a message.
